column1: # REQ-055 post-Muon update geometry: kmax (K-Maxwell) vs agema (age-matched single EMA), seed 0, SHA 365c392d.
# Probe measure_step_geometry.py on consecutive dumps x_S,x_{S+1} (S -> S+1, labeled; NO step trained past the stop).
# Analysis direction = delta_muon = delta_full - delta_wd, delta_wd = -(lr_eff*wd)*x_S (lr=0.025*eta(S), wd=0.05,
# 3 fixed held-out probe minibatches (32768 tok), model.eval(), exact param reset (dL(0.0)=0 verified).
# vHv_fd = gradient central-FD HVP (eps=0.01, local at x_S, cross-matrix terms kept); vHv_scan = loss-scan 2nd diff over +-0.5 delta.
# ACROSS-STEP MEAN of (kmax - agema):  align_joint=-0.0011 (NULL)  vHv_fd=-0.79 (NULL: per-step -15/+8.6/-0.65/+3.6, sign flips, scale ~30-66)  uphill_frac=+0.0000 (NULL)
# VERDICT: the realized MUON step of K-Maxwell is geometrically indistinguishable from the age-matched single EMA.
# Decomposition: weight decay = ~10-11% of ||delta_muon|| every step; non-Muon (embed/proj) displacement (~306-714) dwarfs the Muon step (~1.6-3.8); reconstruction residual ~1e-8 (fp32).
# Curvature cross-check: FD vs loss-scan agree <6% at 2050/2250/2500(kmax); diverge ~45% at 2749 (smallest ||delta||, anharmonic - quadratic breaks down, per the alpha-scan's purpose).
# Overshoot (BOTH arms): loss-scan min at alpha~0.25-0.5, realized alpha=1 near baseline -> Muon step is ~2x its along-direction optimum (edge of stability); shrinks by 2749.
